Run the Sepsis-3 reference pipeline and verify output

Source: R/pipeline.R
run_sepsis3_example.Rd

Runs the full pipeline for the Sepsis-3 cohort: selects and imports it via build_sepsis_cohort(), then runs every remaining stage of run_one_source() (skipping only its own import_cohort stage, already done). Works for any source family with a packaged chain (mimic_iii, mimic_iv, eicu). Useful for verifying the package's DuckDB-backed cohort_sql/setup_sql cohort-selection route works correctly after installation or changes.

Usage

run_sepsis3_example(
  db_name = NULL,
  base_dir = NULL,
  src_name = "mimic_iii_demo",
  raw_data_root = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  bundle = "sepsis3",
  definition = c("delta", "absolute"),
  import_scope = "hospital",
  memory_limit = NULL,
  threads = NULL,
  show_progress = TRUE
)

Arguments

db_name

Optional Postgres database to write to. If NULL, uses the active project config, then "rendehr".

base_dir

Project root with the source's raw demo data.

src_name

Source to run. Default "mimic_iii_demo".

raw_data_root

Optional parent storage-root override for raw source data, forwarded to both build_sepsis_cohort()'s selection step and run_one_source()'s remaining stages.

overwrite

If TRUE, overwrite existing cohort/database output for this source - forwarded to both build_sepsis_cohort() and run_one_source()'s remaining stages. Default FALSE, matching run_one_source()'s own default; needed for re-running the example against a source already imported/loaded.

bundle

Forwarded to build_sepsis_cohort(). Default "sepsis3" - see build_sepsis_cohort()'s own bundle doc for the "first_sepsis3" (first-ICU-stay-only) alternative.

definition

Forwarded to build_sepsis_cohort(): "delta" (default) or "absolute".

import_scope

Forwarded to build_sepsis_cohort(). Default "hospital" - see build_sepsis_cohort()'s own import_scope doc for why this differs from the engine's general NULL (full patient-history) default.

memory_limit, threads

Optional DuckDB resource settings forwarded to build_sepsis_cohort()'s cohort-selection step - useful for a full (non-demo) source on a memory-constrained machine, where scanning a full CHARTEVENTS-sized table can exceed DuckDB's default memory cap.

show_progress

Forwarded to build_sepsis_cohort() - prints which setup_sql file is running, with elapsed seconds.

Value

Invisibly returns NULL.

Details

Requires the source's raw demo data under the project's raw data root. The database is the project config's db_name (or db_name), not the target of ehr_connect().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ehr_connect("sepsis3_example", creds)
run_sepsis3_example(base_dir = "/path/to/project")
run_sepsis3_example(src_name = "eicu_demo", base_dir = "/path/to/project")
run_sepsis3_example(base_dir = "/path/to/project", bundle = "first_sepsis3")
} # }
